description: Header file defining data structures and function prototypes for MIME type caching using memory-mapped caches in the xdgmime library.

classes.name: XdgMimeCache
classes.description: Data structure representing a MIME type cache, details not specified in this header.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_cache_new_from_file
methods.description: Creates a new MIME cache from a specified file.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_cache_unref
methods.description: Decreases reference count and potentially frees the MIME cache.

methods.name: _xdg_mime_cache_get_mime_type_from_file_name
methods.description: Retrieves MIME type based on a file name.
